name: Japan Highway Racer VR
summary:
Welcome to Japan Highway Racer VR, the ultimate high-speed street racing experience that puts you in the driver’s seat of powerful cars, tearing through neon-lit highways and bustling city streets. Drift around sharp corners, push your car to its limits on the open road, and race against the fastest drivers across Japan. Every second counts—do you have what it takes to become the undisputed highway legend?
